metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an upper trapezius stretch that may quickly release tightness and stiffness in the neck.

Also, this exercise provides a deep neck stretch that may end in a satisfying self pop, crack, or release. No equipment is needed, and this can be done at home or work. 

Let us know how it works for you!
